summary: Verified bug fix for product detail pages (sparse array holes causing productBySlug crash). Tested all 10 deep-link product detail URLs, /products listing order, /gallery, homepage, and client-side card navigation on preview URL. All pages render with correct h1, no runtime/console errors, no blank screens.

Card-click client-side navigation was verified as an equivalent proof. If dropdown testid was expected, main agent should confirm it is rendered (may be hover-only/collapsed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified on https://print-shop-test.preview.emergentagent.com. All 10 /products/<slug> pages render (h1 matches product name, body content present, 0 errors). Listing at /products shows 10 products in correct order. Gallery /gallery loads. Homepage loads. Card click from /products navigates client-side to detail page successfully. Header 'products-dropdown' data-testid not found — used card click as alternative client-side nav verification.
rca of the issue: Root cause: sparse JS array in frontend/src/data/products.js — stray commas created undefined holes. Array.find visited holes as undefined so `productBySlug` threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading slug)'. Fix (already applied): removed stray commas leaving 10 clean entries + defensive `p && p.slug === slug` guard on line 264. Verified working.
